import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
from evaluate_pose import preflight_dataset
from stage_pose_training import source_state
from package_composed_results import validate_protocol
context = validate_protocol(root, sys.argv[1])
assert context['sha256'] == sys.argv[2]
initial = preflight_dataset(root, require_weights=True)
roles = context['document']['roles']
assert set(roles) == {'reference', 'candidate'}
shared_manifest = {spec['candidate_manifest'] for spec in roles.values()}
assert len(shared_manifest) == 1, 'Both arms must use the same composed manifest.'
state = source_state(root, root / next(iter(shared_manifest)))
assert len(state['records']) == 157
assert state['source']['initial_checkpoint_sha256'] == initial['model_sha256']
assert state['counts']['reference']['val'] == state['counts']['candidate']['val']
counts = {}
for role, spec in roles.items():
    assert spec['arm'] == role, 'Protocol role and actual runner arm must agree.'
    assert all(state['source'][key] == spec[key] for key in
               ('candidate_manifest', 'candidate_manifest_sha256', 'candidate_id'))
    counts[role] = state['counts'][role]
# The corrected development reference is checked separately; stage_pose_training
# continues to use the unchanged original validation labels in both arms.
from evaluate_pose import file_sha256
from rescore_reference_amendment import load_api, verify_amendment
from replay_corner_reference import reference_counts
evaluation = context['document']['evaluation']
reference_path = root / evaluation['primary_reference']
assert file_sha256(reference_path) == evaluation['primary_reference_sha256']
_, api = load_api(root)
reference, gold, *_ = verify_amendment(root, reference_path.parent, initial, api)
evaluation_counts, locatable_groups = reference_counts(gold)
assert evaluation_counts == reference['counts'] == {
    'images': 20, 'objects': 663, 'visible_endpoints': 1227,
    'missing_endpoints': 99, 'empty_images': 3}
assert locatable_groups == reference['objects_by_locatable_corners'] == {'0': 20, '1': 59, '2': 584}
assert evaluation_counts['objects'] == evaluation['all_object_denominator']
assert evaluation_counts['visible_endpoints'] == evaluation['locatable_endpoint_denominator']
assert locatable_groups['2'] == evaluation['both_corner_denominator']
print(json.dumps({'status':'verified', 'original_images':157, 'label_counts':counts,
                  'weights_verified':initial['weights_verified'],
                  'protocol_sha256':context['sha256'],
                  'delta_train_image_ids':context['delta_train_image_ids'],
                  'evaluation_reference_counts':evaluation_counts,
                  'evaluation_objects_by_locatable_corners':locatable_groups}, indent=2))
